description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Cost 3 Vitae

Range 30 feet

Area 20-foot burst

Saving Throw basic Reflex

You throw every prepared Graft you have left at once. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 damage per Graft expended this way, of a damage type you choose from among those Grafts. Every Graft spent is consumed regardless of the result.

cinderfall.incomplete: Damage scales as "1d6 per Graft expended this way," depending on how many Grafts the caster has prepared at cast time. No confirmed mechanism in pf2e resolves "count of a specific consumable item currently held/prepared" as roll data for a damage formula -- flagged as a genuine judgment call rather than asserted either way, and not shipped without that confirmation.
